mapper.select: SELECT NVL(t.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount FROM (SELECT LEVEL AS month_num FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM'))) months LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(po.in_date, 'MM') AS month, SUM(pi.purchase_item_cnt * pi.purchase_item_cost) AS total_amount FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN purchase_item pi ON po.purchase_no = pi.purchase_no WHERE TO_CHAR(po.in_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(#{value}) AND po.del_status = 0 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(po.in_date, 'MM') ) t ON TO_CHAR(months.month_num, 'FM00') = t.month ORDER BY months.month_num

SELECT NVL(t.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount FROM (SELECT LEVEL AS month_num FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM'))) months LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(so.in_date, 'MM') AS month, SUM(si.sales_item_cnt * si.sales_item_cost) AS total_amount FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN sales_item si ON so.sales_no = si.sales_no WHERE TO_CHAR(so.in_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(#{value}) AND so.del_status = 0 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(so.in_date, 'MM') ) t ON TO_CHAR(months.month_num, 'FM00') = t.month ORDER BY months.month_num

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.client_name, NVL(SUM(si.totalcost), 0) AS totalcost FROM client c JOIN sales_order so ON c.client_no = so.client_no AND so.del_status = 0 AND so.in_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -6) JOIN ( SELECT sales_no, SUM(sales_item_cnt * sales_item_cost) AS totalcost FROM sales_item GROUP BY sales_no ) si ON so.sales_no = si.sales_no WHERE c.del_status = 0 AND c.client_gubun = 1 GROUP BY c.client_name ORDER BY totalcost DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT client_name, totalcost FROM ( SELECT c.client_name, NVL(SUM(pi.totalcost), 0) AS totalcost FROM client c JOIN purchase_order po ON c.client_no = po.client_no AND po.del_status = 0 AND po.in_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -6) JOIN ( SELECT purchase_no, SUM(purchase_item_cnt * purchase_item_cost) AS totalcost FROM purchase_item GROUP BY purchase_no ) pi ON po.purchase_no = pi.purchase_no WHERE c.del_status = 0 AND c.client_gubun = 0 GROUP BY c.client_name ORDER BY totalcost DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

WITH months AS ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -6 + LEVEL - 1) AS month_date FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS each_month, NVL(SUM(si.totalCost), 0) AS item_totalCost FROM months m LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM sales_order WHERE del_status = 0) so ON TRUNC(so.in_date, 'MM') = m.month_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_no, SUM(sales_item_outcnt*sales_item_cost) as totalCost FROM sales_item WHERE product_no = #{value} GROUP BY sales_no) si ON so.sales_no = si.sales_no GROUP BY m.month_date ORDER BY m.month_date

WITH months AS ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -6 + LEVEL - 1) AS month_date FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS each_month, NVL(SUM(pi.totalCost), 0) AS item_totalCost FROM months m LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM purchase_order WHERE del_status = 0) po ON TRUNC(po.in_date, 'MM') = m.month_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT purchase_no, SUM(purchase_item_incnt*purchase_item_cost) as totalCost FROM purchase_item WHERE parts_no = #{value} GROUP BY purchase_no) pi ON po.purchase_no = pi.purchase_no GROUP BY m.month_date ORDER BY m.month_date
SELECT client_no, client_name FROM client WHERE del_status = 0 AND client_gubun = 1 AND LOWER(client_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%')
